name: visa_check_insurance
description: Verify travel insurance meets Schengen visa requirements (Article 15 of the Schengen Visa Code). Validates: minimum €30,000 medical coverage stated in EUR, emergency medical repatriation, geographic scope covering all Schengen states, and full trip date coverage. Returns PASS/FAIL with specific issues and fix actions.

provider_name.description: Name of the insurance provider / insurer

coverage_amount.description: Stated coverage amount for medical expenses

coverage_currency.description: Currency of the coverage amount (e.g. EUR, GBP, USD)

start_date.description: First day of insurance coverage in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD) or natural language

end_date.description: Last day of insurance coverage in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD) or natural language

covers_repatriation.description: Whether the policy explicitly covers emergency medical repatriation
